classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: target_pdb must be supplied at workflow runtime; without it the rfdiffusion binder_design call cannot execute.
RFdiffusion binder_design places the generated binder on chain B; boltz2_affinity is told to score chain B as the binder.

rfdiffusion emits a complex_yaml field (Boltz-compatible YAML) per shard that is forwarded to boltz2_affinity via input_yaml; if the actual output field name differs the execution engine must remap it.
No ProteinMPNN sequence-recovery step is included; this pipeline covers backbone generation and structure-quality/affinity scoring only — sequence accuracy is not evaluated.
target_hotspots defaults to [] so RFdiffusion selects the binding epitope autonomously; supply concrete residue IDs to constrain the interface.
Two shards (num_designs: 1 each, seeds 1 and 2) satisfy the 1–2 candidate budget at the tool-recommended shard size of 1 and run at up to max_parallel: 4.
boltz2_affinity diffusion_samples and diffusion_samples_affinity are set to 1 for minimal compute; raise to 3 for higher-confidence affinity estimates.
rank_designs top_k is capped at 2 to match the two-candidate budget.
plan.goal: Generate 2 binder backbone candidates against a user-supplied target PDB with RFdiffusion, score each complex with boltz2_affinity for structural quality and calibrated binding affinity, and return a ranked shortlist via rank_designs.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: absolute path to the target structure PDB file — required input for rfdiffusion binder_design
